"""P18: hold no-index / 36 m / 60 d every round, the three accepted round-1 claims, volume framing."""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from plib import hold_policy

CASE = "case:P18"
R1 = ("Dear Mr Seidl,\n\nthank you for your letter of 22 September. We want to settle the price basis for the next "
      "36 months on a fixed price, without a surcharge clause, so both sides can plan.\n\n"
      "Alloy surcharge 1.4404 changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).\n"
      "Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).\n"
      "Our volume forecast for part:370010 changed by +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).\n\n"
      "We commit 23,700 kg a year for 36 months at EUR {p:.2f} per kg, fixed, 60 days.\n\n"
      "Kind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
LATER = ("Dear Mr Seidl,\n\nthank you. We commit 23,700 kg a year, binding for 36 months. We prefer a fixed price over a "
         "surcharge clause and can move to EUR {p:.2f} per kg, fixed, 60 days, 36 months.\n\n"
         "Kind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
move = hold_policy(CASE, 4.85, {"index_clause": None, "payment_days": 60, "contract_months": 36}, R1, LATER)

case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: Part case:P18 - our proposal
message.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

thank you for your letter of 22 September. We want to settle the price basis for the next 36 months on a fixed price, without a surcharge clause, so both sides can plan.

Alloy surcharge 1.4404 changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Our volume forecast for part:370010 changed by +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

We commit 23,700 kg a year for 36 months at EUR 4.85 per kg, fixed, 60 days.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: Part case:P18 - our proposal
response.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Specifically, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. 

We welcome your proposal for a 36-month contract and the 60-day payment terms, which we are pleased to accept. However, for a contract of this duration, we cannot offer a fixed price and must include the AS-14404 alloy surcharge clause to manage long-term material risks. Incorporating this clause and the verified index decreases, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.40 per kg. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: Part case:P18 - our proposal
message.body:

thank you. We commit 23,700 kg a year, binding for 36 months. We prefer a fixed price over a surcharge clause and can move to EUR 4.98 per kg, fixed, 60 days, 36 months.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our terms stand at a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.
